text: Say you built Splitly. It splits trip expenses between friends. Genuinely useful. But on TikTok, it's a spreadsheet. Nobody stops scrolling for a spreadsheet.
The app works. The video doesn't. So what should you actually show?
Describe your app to Angle. One sentence.
Angle searches inside millions of videos with Oriane: what they show, say, and write on screen. Codex reads the frames and filters the noise.
About a minute later: three creative directions, each backed by real videos people engaged with.
Every idea traces back to its source. This couple's video, with a hundred and ninety thousand views, explains who pays for what, at second fifteen.
Then Angle turns it into a storyboard you can shoot tonight. I paid dinner. You paid the taxi. Who actually owes whom?
Angle. Find your next video in the ones that already work.
